cases.name: Mistfen Ferry Landing
cases.brief: A reed-lined marsh landing with a timber ferry pier, mooring posts and a step-free approach from a land spawn to the passenger platform.

decision.concern: The boarding edge is thin at native size.
decision.rootCause: The end of the deck uses the same implicit top and front edge hierarchy as the rest of the dock.
decision.target: The three-pixel-wide interior band immediately before the boarding lip.
decision.protected: All pixels outside the target, all foreground actors and solid props, every geometry and navigation mask.

cases.name: Floodgate Maintenance Yard
cases.brief: A stone and timber sluice maintenance yard with a channel, a paired gate tower, a dock-sized inspection platform and land-to-platform access.
